task.title: Block or report someone
task.shortdesc: Block someone to stop them from seeing your name or profile on Nearby or saying hi. Report them to tell support; reporting also blocks them.

taskbody.context: You can block or report before or after you match. The person isn't told.

step.cmd: Tap … on the person's card on Nearby, on the Match screen, or in your chat with them.
step.info: You can also touch and hold their card. The hi sheet and a note's options offer Block and Report too.

chrow.chdesc: Confirm on Block name?. You then see You blocked this person.
Pick a reason: Fake profile, Harassment, Inappropriate content, Under 18, or Something else. Then tap Report and block. An email to support opens so you can send the details.

postreq.note: Version has no way to unblock someone.
